scope: Eight additional regressions for the 73 survivors of campaign v3; complete campaign v4 finished and failed

review.contract: 520 one-bit weights split into exactly 65 eight-term BMLS blocks at a 25-byte inclusive cap; report charges one 64-bit word per tree.
Cache caps of 64 and 65 bytes cannot retain a certificate plus the 64-byte entry allowance; all three repeated weights require synthesis.
A zero-rank descriptor reports TensorShape at the rank field rather than an unrelated offset.
A Unix symlink destination resolving to the source returns SourceDestinationConflict, preserving source bytes.
Explicit abort accepts an already absent spool and leaves no published destination.
A missing parent yields CreateTemporary/NotFound rather than exhausting name collisions or fabricating AlreadyExists.
Object and array nesting at container depth eight is accepted by bounded parsing; excessive depth returns InvalidValue before schema validation.

Preflight accepts descriptors ending exactly at EOF, accounts 47 catalog bytes plus three bookkeeping records as 1144 bytes, accepts that cap and rejects 1143. This does not assert that a payload-free GGUF is a complete valid model.

complete_campaign_v4.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo mutants -p bml-model-weights --all-features --cargo-arg=--locked --test-workspace false --jobs 2 --timeout 60 --build-timeout 300 --output target/model-weights-mutations-v4
